# FastAPI v0.162.2 Multi-Portal Documentation & Diagnostic Suite (Unofficial Drawlib & PNI501 Showcase)

> Unofficial community documentation, API catalog, internal architecture walkthrough, and PNI501 software audit of FastAPI v0.162.2 (`https://fastapi.drawlib.com/`).
> Official FastAPI documentation: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/

## Portals

- [FastAPI User Guide (EN/JA)](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/user_guide/): Practical developer guide, 100k+ LOC modular monolith patterns, OAuth2/JWT + WebSocket Security, native SSE, OpenTelemetry, and SPA mounts (`https://fastapi.drawlib.com/user_guide/llms.txt`).
- [FastAPI API Reference Catalog (EN/JA)](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/): Searchable symbol & CLI reference catalog (`https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/llms.txt`).
- [FastAPI Internal Architecture Guide (EN/JA)](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/architecture/): Source-level guide to FastAPI v0.162.2 internals (`https://fastapi.drawlib.com/architecture/llms.txt`).
- [PNI501 Diagnostic Report (HTML & PDF)](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/pni501/): Deterministic 15-stage code, dependency DAG, test coverage, and security audit (`https://fastapi.drawlib.com/pni501/pni501.pdf`, `https://fastapi.drawlib.com/pni501/llms.txt`).
